summary: Iteration 13 - Live MEXC Data Integration Verified & Frontend Bug Fixed. All backend APIs returning correct data with live MEXC prices. Fixed critical frontend bug where Trading page was showing stale/empty data due to slow opportunities endpoint blocking data fetch.

Solution: Separated fast endpoints from slow opportunities endpoint - now fetches critical data first, then opportunities in background

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live MEXC data integration fully working. Frontend Trading page now properly displays live positions with real-time prices from MEXC exchange. PnL chart component visible. All positions show entry_price, current_price, stop_price, target_price, pnl_pct, and confidence.

/api/trading/v2/pnl-history.returns: Trade history with cumulative PnL for chart
